neighbours.label: a set-up for a reveal: 'you guessed it', 'But what X didn't know (was)', 'What they found'
fire: The biggest buyer of the company's chips is, you guessed it, the government.
Every year the prize goes to, you guessed it, the same three families.
Tom bought the house in a hurry. But what he didn't know was that it flooded every spring.
The ingredient that makes it so sweet is, you guessed it, more sugar.
She planned the party for weeks. But what she didn't realise was that he already knew.
Researchers scanned the fish for a year. What they found in the samples was alarming.
And the town that wins the award again this year is, you guessed it, our own.
He trained hard for the race. But what nobody told him was that it had been cancelled.
quiet: The biggest buyer of the company's chips is the government, according to the report.
Every year the prize goes to the same three families in the valley.
Tom bought the house in a hurry, and it flooded every spring after that.
The ingredient that makes it so sweet is simply more sugar than usual.
She planned the party for weeks, although he already knew about it.
Researchers scanned the fish for a year and found alarming levels in the samples.
The town that wins the award again this year is our own, the paper says.
He trained hard for the race, and then it was cancelled at the last minute.

notes: Card - pole top: 'you guessed it', 'but what he didnt know', 'What's more', sentence-initial 'But'/'What' before a reveal.
